details.refs: The black upper unit, monitor, glass-door bottle fridge, ash lower doors with ring pulls, bright nosing and guard rail are all consistent with samchui_11 and ANA's 2019 render. I could not find a new in-service photo of the bar, and the skeptic marks it down for that. The 1.05 m depth is accepted.

omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32.jpg and kna_31_full.jpg (KN Aviation, 2021, an in-service photo of the same unit at night) are real photos. The layout matches: control panel over two ovens on the left, the monitor in the centre over the brewer bays, a tall glass cabinet on the right, a placard above, a black counter and ash lower doors. Two mismatches: the ovens render dark grey (#464646) against silver (#928e79), and the glass cabinet is an opaque blue-black slab (#15181f) against a see-through smoked glass with shelves visible (#3d3a36).
There is no new photo. The ash wall with framed flaps, the 7K galley and the 2R jump seat are clean. The passage orientation is still a user question.

issues.problem: The F-front aisle curtains are modelled as tied hourglass bundles with a tie band (addCurtain(..., tied = true) for tone 'F'). In-service photos show loose full-height drapes about 0.5-0.6 m wide hanging straight from the track, gathered loosely against the wall edge, with no tieback.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/omaatF_ANA-First-Class-Suite-777-40.jpg (left aisle: a closed drape spans the opening, #47413f); ref/web/monuments/ml_DSC_1914.jpg (an open drape bunched at the left aisle edge, no tie); render q01 and m02 (hourglass bundles with a tie band at 1.45-1.55 m)
issues.fix: In buildMonuments, where the F/J and F-front curtains call addCurtain (line ~727), pass tied = false for tone 'F' at the F front only. Then give _curtainPanel an 'F' variant: hx about 0.25, amp 0.35, lobes 13, slightly wider at the hem, set against the monument edge so the aisle keeps 0.45 m or more.

issues.problem: The tall cabinet on the right of the welcome galley renders as an opaque blue-black slab (#15181f) with a small grey square latch. The real unit is smoked glass: two shelves, stowed items and a lit interior show through it. A round latch boss sits on the left stile at mid-height, and there is a caution placard at the top of the frame.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32.jpg (glass #3d3a36 with shelves visible, a round latch at the left stile, a white caution text block at the top); ref/web/monuments/kna_31_full.jpg (the same cabinet with a small lit display behind the glass); render m03 and m16
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley, under the 'right: tall glass-door cabinet' block: replace the {c:'#2c3036'} quad with MONMAT.fridgeLit at about 60 % opacity, or put a dim interior (back panel #3b3834 plus 2-3 gBox shelves at 1.2 / 1.45 / 1.7 and a few grey boxes) behind a glass quad. Replace the gRBox latch with a ring (gCyl r 0.04 in aluDark plus an inner boss, like the bar fridge latch at line ~228) at gc - 0.17. Add a 0.18 × 0.06 white label quad at y 1.8.

issues.problem: The aluminium ovens and inserts render dark charcoal (#353535-#464646), but the in-service welcome galley shows bright silver-grey ovens with large curved lever handles and blue meal cards. As a result every galley reads as black and dark grey.
issues.evidence: omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32.jpg: ovens #928e79, which is lighter than the ash lower doors (#a68f67) in the same light. Renders: m16 ovens #464646 against ash doors #ada18a, and m01 #353535.
issues.fix: Raise MONMAT.alu to about #c4c2bc with a lower metalness (m 0.45) so it does not go dark in the dim galley environment. Make the oven handle (aluDark gRBox in buildWelcomeGalley and buildGalley t===0) a 0.16 m tall C-shaped lever. If the darkness comes from the AO volume inside the set-back recess, flag it to lighting and integration.

issues.problem: The ebony is still flat, with no streaked grain, for the third round running. It reads as a brown slab next to the grained seat shells in omaatF_40 (dark wood with strong horizontal streaks).
issues.evidence: q01 (closet faces a smooth gradient around #3e3935), m19 (flat corridor walls); omaatF_ANA-First-Class-Suite-777-40.jpg (streaked ebony edge trims on the suites)
issues.fix: Give MONMAT.darkWood a streak layer: reuse the suite's ebony swatch from tex/ if one exists (shared LAYER in 03_tex.js), or bake vertical streak vertex colours as inkWall does (a 0.05 m strip grid with ±12 % value noise).
